mentions.name: Gaming Couch
mentions.description: A web-based local multiplayer party game platform offering 20+ competitive, action-based mini-games playable free in early access. Games run in the browser with no downloads or installs; players use phones as controllers (gamepads also work), each game supports up to 8 players, and quick ~1-minute rounds keep the pace. It avoids language-based trivia and turn-based games so groups with mixed language fluency can play together. The platform also provides third-party development tools (in private beta) that let game developers publish their own party minigames, and the first third-party game has already launched.
mentions.problem: Local multiplayer game nights involve too much hassle switching between titles and connecting 4-8 controllers to one PC or console, and existing options like Jackbox rely too heavily on language, failing for groups with members not fluent in English.
mentions.audience: Groups of friends for local multiplayer game nights (including non-English speakers); game developers building party minigames for the platform.
